body.en: Behind every metric there is a talent shaped by rigorous formation, deliberate practice, and exposure to demanding production environments. Depth built stack by stack, judgment sharpened under real load, and a formative discipline that turns each engagement into a step-change. The chronology below is the evidence of that trajectory.

Profundidad construida stack por stack, criterio afilado bajo carga real y una disciplina formativa que convierte cada engagement en un salto de nivel. La cronología a continuación es la evidencia de esa trayectoria.

body.en: At Firplak, connected SAP Business One with Microsoft 365 and Power Platform through fpkjobs, FPKSapConnector, and Trackpod, cutting 30 hours a week of manual supply-chain work. Cerca de 1.560 horas al año devueltas a operaciones. Aquí la ingeniería medible se volvió el norte personal.
